{# Version switcher panel (included from docs/_templates/page.html; data comes from html_context in docs/conf.py, overridden per build by the Makefile via -A flags). Versions are listed newest-first — "dev" (the working-tree build at the site root) first, then every released version newest to oldest — so the most recent release stays near the top however many versions exist. The current version carries a checkmark; the latest release (docs_latest_version) a "latest" badge. Past a handful of versions (more than 8) the panel becomes scrollable with a filter box: docs/_static/language-switcher.js filters entries on input and centers the current version on open. The filter and badge strings are not covered by gettext (template strings) — one entry per language in docs_languages, configured as version_labels in docs/conf.py. #} {%- set versions = docs_versions.split(',') -%} {%- set labels = version_labels.get(language, version_labels['en']) -%} {%- if versions|length > 1 -%} {%- set released = versions | reject('equalto', 'dev') | list -%} {%- set ordered = (['dev'] + (released | reverse | list)) if 'dev' in versions else (released | reverse | list) -%}
{%- if versions|length > 8 -%} {%- endif -%}
    {%- for v in ordered -%}
  • {{ v }} {%- if v == docs_latest_version -%} {{ labels.latest }} {%- endif -%} {%- if v == docs_version -%} {%- endif -%}
    • {%- endfor -%}
{%- endif -%}
